title: The Ward Residency
logline: An apprentice surgeon discovers their mentor is testing experimental synthetic organ grafts on comatose quarantine patients.

roles.description: Chief medical educator aboard the isolation ward; obsessive, brilliant, and convinced academic breakthroughs forgive ethical shortcuts.
A top surgical resident who took the medical pledge seriously and noticed discrepancy marks in the autopsy logs.
Funds the medical residency program in exchange for proprietary biological trial data.
A sterile, isolated habitat ring where miners exposed to toxic asteroid fumes are treated.
A high-speed blockade runner carrying proprietary chemical catalysts for synthetic organ cultures.
The mutual aid fraternal order representing sick asteroid labourers.

public_situation: Apprentice medics at {system}'s isolation hospital work around the clock as lung-rot cases from the deep asteroid veins overwhelm the intake docks.
private_truth: The mentor surgeon is secretly implanting unlicensed bio-synthetic alveolar matrices into comatose miners to fulfill corporate clinical trial quotas.

beats.public_change: The hospital intake announces an emergency shortage of sterile surgical sealants.

missions.reason: The chief surgeon needs forty ampoules of medical grade coagulant purchased from an outer depot to maintain ward operations.
missions.private_fact: The coagulants are actually special immunosuppressants needed to prevent the experimental synthetic organs from rejecting.

beats.public_change: The apprentice medic locks the bio-waste incinerator room after discovering anomalous tissue cultures.

missions.reason: The apprentice asks the pilot to scan the hospital's internal telemetry bus and pull the deleted surgical records.
missions.private_fact: Six miners who officially died of toxic gas inhalation actually suffered acute rejection of unapproved corporate synthetic lung implants.

beats.public_change: A corporate pharma courier arrives in the system to retrieve the clinical trial data drive.

missions.reason: The apprentice begs the pilot to intercept the pharma courier before it docks and takes custody of the patient logs.
missions.private_fact: The courier hails mid-fight, offering a lucrative pharmaceutical patent stake if the pilot escorts the drive safely to the broker.

beats.public_change: The miners' fellowship convenes an emergency assembly at the ward perimeter demanding answers.

missions.reason: The apprentice asks the pilot to deliver the extracted trial data drive to the fellowship delegation before security raids the ward.
missions.private_fact: The apprentice's own medical licence will be revoked as an accomplice if the scandal breaks without an official immunity grant.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot stands at the ward airlock with the clinical records. The apprentice demands accountability, while the mentor pleads that the research will cure all lung rot.

options.label: Deliver the evidence to the miners' fellowship to prosecute the medical experimentation
Broker a quiet settlement granting free patented treatment to all affected families
Sell the research data drive to the pharma liaison for a private windfall

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the records to the miners' fellowship.
resolutions.summary: {role:mentor_surgeon} is stripped of credentials and jailed, while {role:apprentice_medic} takes over the clinic under miners' oversight.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot exposed an eminent surgeon using dying miners as guinea pigs for corporate patents.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a restitution pact between the clinic and miners.
resolutions.summary: {role:pharma_liaison} funds lifetime care for afflicted miners, keeping {role:mentor_surgeon}'s research alive under strict joint supervision.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the pharma deal or sells the research drive.
resolutions.summary: The trial data enters corporate hands; {role:mentor_surgeon} receives a major patent promotion while {role:apprentice_medic} flees the system.

resolutions.reached_by: The deliveries fail or the pilot drops the contract.
resolutions.summary: The hospital board buries the audit and closes the ward; untreated miners are evicted while {role:apprentice_medic} is blacklisted.

loose_threads.detail: Vials of experimental graft tissue carry patent codes licensed to an off-world commercial cosmetics and longevity syndicate.
The residency hospital's endowment charter lists an uncollateralized loan with an aggressive acceleration clause.

radio_hooks: Quarantine ward in {system} reports surge in chronic dust lung among belt drillers.
Chief surgeon appeals for emergency medical supplies amid supply chain delays.
Miners' fraternal league holds candlelight vigil outside hospital airlocks.

voice_direction.mentor_surgeon: Clinical, patrician, speaking with the cold intellectual warmth of a visionary who views individual lives as rounding errors.
voice_direction.apprentice_medic: Distressed, earnest, speaking with fastidious medical precision while struggling to maintain professional composure.
voice_direction.pharma_liaison: Silky, dismissive, speaking in corporate venture euphemisms and treating ethical objections as bargaining tactics.
